meta.title: Services
meta.description: Optional services next to TNP Network: public DNS domains and their DNS zones, through trusted providers.

heading: Services
subtitle: An optional area next to TNP Network for public DNS domains and their zones, through trusted providers. TNP Network — native names, resolution and service publication — works the same with or without it.
signInPrompt: Sign in to search public domains and manage the ones you own.

errors.network: Could not reach the TNP API. Check your connection and try again.

notAvailable.heading: Services are not available yet
notAvailable.body: Public domain search, quotes and DNS management have not been enabled on this TNP deployment. Nothing here can be searched or bought yet.
notAvailable.unreachable: The services status could not be checked right now.

namespace.tnpExplain: Native names such as .ox live in TNP's own namespace and resolve through TNP.
namespace.publicExplain: Public domains such as .com are registered through a provider and resolve through the public DNS, exactly as they would without TNP.
namespace.notNative: Buying a public domain such as a .com does not make it a TNP name.

provider.sandboxHint: Registered in the provider's test environment: not a real registration.

blocked.sales_disabled: Domain sales are not enabled. You can search and see prices, but nothing can be bought here yet.
blocked.payments_not_configured: Payments are not connected yet. You can search and see prices, but nothing can be bought here yet.

zone.heading: DNS zone
zone.none: No DNS zone is recorded for this domain.
zone.conflictState: The zone was changed outside TNP since it was last read. Preview again to see the current records before editing.
zone.external: This zone is managed outside TNP. Edit its records where it is hosted; TNP does not publish changes to it.
zone.editingDisabled: DNS editing is not enabled yet.
zone.previewFailed: The preview could not be generated. Try again.
zone.conflict: The zone changed since your preview. Preview again before applying.
zone.applyNetwork: The request did not get an answer. Retrying is safe: the same change will not be applied twice.
zone.applyFailed: The change could not be applied. Try again.
zone.noDifference: These changes would not alter the zone.
zone.raceNotice: The provider has no way to lock the zone: an edit made in the provider's own panel at the same time can still conflict with this change.
zone.pollingStopped: Still being checked. This page stopped asking; refresh the operation log later.
zone.confirmConsequence: The whole zone is rewritten at the provider with these records. Removed records stop resolving once the change is published.
